pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with jagged, stellate-like margins showing moderate-to-high edge gradients; patches on the lower flank appear smaller and more fragmented than those on the mid-torso.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored negative space with variable pixel thickness; junction nodes primarily manifest as triradiate and tetraradiate intersections forming a stable topological graph across the visible flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, high-frequency serration along the dorsal neck ridge; the silhouette presents a continuous jagged profile with consistent amplitude against the sky background.
